title: High Molecular Weight (HMW) DNA Extraction Protocol for Tissue Sample
author: Aswini Leela Loganathan

steps.title: Lyse tissue sample
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL lysis buffer to 50–150 mg finely cut tissue and mix.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL Proteinase K to the lysate and vortex for 10 seconds.

steps.title: Digest proteins
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture on a shaking incubator at 55 °C for 2 hours (or until the tissue is dissolved).

steps.title: Add RNase
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL RNase to the tube and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Incubate for RNA degradation
steps.instruction: Incubate on a shaking incubator at 37 °C (duration not specified).

steps.title: Extract with phenol‑chloroform
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (ratio 25:24:1) and vortex until an emulsion forms.

steps.title: Phase separation centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at room temperature for 10 minutes at 10 000 × g.

steps.title: Collect aqueous layer
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL of the upper aqueous phase to a new tube.

steps.title: Neutralize DNA
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL 3 M sodium acetate (1/10th volume) and vortex gently, avoiding bubbles.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 440 µL ice‑cold 100 % ethanol (2 volumes) and mix gently by inverting the tube.

steps.title: Cold precipitation incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at –20 °C for 2 hours.

steps.title: Pellet DNA by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10 000 × g, room temperature, for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Ethanol wash of DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with ice‑cold 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Wash centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 2 minutes at 10 000 × g (room temperature).

steps.title: Repeat ethanol washes
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 13 and 14 two additional times (total three washes).

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 35 µL elution buffer (EB) and mix gently using a wide‑bore tip or by tapping.
